findings.issue: Workspace member list returns email field in API response — all workspace members can see each other's email addresses
findings.impact: PII (email addresses) exposed to all workspace members unnecessarily; email enumeration across workspace membership
findings.fix: Remove email from getMembers() SELECT query; return only display_name and avatar_url; log access for audit

findings.issue: GDPR delete route does not clean up audit_logs or consent_logs — user's data remains after account deletion
findings.impact: GDPR Right to Erasure not fully implemented; user's audit trail and consent records persist after deletion
findings.fix: Add explicit deletion of audit_logs and consent_logs entries for the user in the GDPR delete endpoint

findings.issue: User email logged in workspace list operations via userEmail in authenticate middleware — PII in structured logs
findings.impact: Email addresses flow into production log aggregation services where retention may be long and access broad
findings.fix: Log only userId, not userEmail; if email is needed for debugging, mask it (e.g., j***@example.com)

findings.issue: User search endpoint returns email in search results — GET /v1/auth/search?q= partial email search enabled
findings.impact: Email enumeration via search — attacker can probe if specific email addresses have accounts on the platform
findings.fix: Exclude email from search results entirely; search only by display_name; rate-limit search to 10 queries/min/user

findings.issue: No data retention policy enforced — audit_logs and notifications grow unbounded; no scheduled purge exists
findings.impact: User data retained indefinitely; GDPR 'right to be forgotten' lifecycle not implemented; storage grows without bound
findings.fix: Implement pg_cron scheduled job to purge audit_logs > 90 days, notifications > 30 days, consent_logs > 1 year; document retention periods

findings.issue: avatar_url stored as raw TEXT with no validation — could contain tracking pixels or external references that leak user activity
findings.impact: Third-party tracking via avatar URLs: when email clients load avatars, referer headers leak workspace context
findings.fix: Proxy avatar images through API server; add Content-Security-Policy: img-src 'self'; validate avatar URLs against allowlist

findings.issue: No data processing register or GDPR compliance documentation in repository
findings.impact: Cannot demonstrate GDPR compliance without documented data processing activities
findings.fix: Create docs/compliance/gdpr-data-processing-register.md listing all PII fields, processing purposes, retention periods, and lawful bases
